claim: American Indian and Alaska Native households experience housing need (overcrowding, cost burden, substandard plumbing or kitchen) at rates above the national baseline.
method: American Community Survey 5-year estimates, AIAN alone or in combination, tabulated by tribal area; households classified by income relative to area median income (under 30 percent, 30 to 50, 50 to 80), by overcrowding (more than one person per room), by housing cost burden (over 50 percent of income), and by lack of complete plumbing or kitchen. Counts per tribe compared with the national all-households rate.
decision: allocation of Indian Housing Block Grant funds among tribes under the federal need formula
native: count of AIAN households in each need category, per tribal area
source: decision string PARAPHRASES the need component of the IHBG allocation formula (24 CFR 1000.324); the regulation text could not be fetched from this environment (egress blocked) and must be replaced with the verbatim factor list before a model run
